_comment: Baseline CLASS + RACE art from bg3.wiki — the DEFAULT fallback portrait for GENERATED player-characters with no canon portrait (a generated Tiefling Rogue falls back to race:tiefling / class:rogue art instead of a blank placeholder). Canon NPCs are covered by manifest_images_characters.json. Official wiki images are © Larian → land ONLY in gitignored content/worlds/_private/<world>/images/ (owner local play, never committed). Scopes use the colon form (class:fighter / race:tiefling) to mirror the existing portrait:<slug> convention, which the viewer's _safe_scope renders as class_fighter / race_tiefling dirs; the /image?scope= endpoint resolves class-fighter / race-tiefling via its normalized-key fallback. Re-run: python3 tools/ingest/wiki_images.py tools/ingest/manifest_images_classes.json
